title: Aaron Rodgers: Sanctity of the locker room doesn't protect the coach from accountability

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Aaron Rodgers: Sanctity of the locker room doesn't protect the coach from accountability
sources.description: With Al Michaels calling today's game in Pittsburgh, ex-Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers texted Michaels to give his side of the nasty breakup he just had with the team and head coach Mike McCarthy.
